thread:
alex: Quick proposal — run a 3-week rolling micro-cohort program (8 partners per cohort) to validate inbound DP asks and prioritization signals. Focus: recruitment velocity, friction points, and two launch success metrics (quality delta, infra cost delta).

maria: love the rolling part. smaller cohorts make it easier to iterate. what's the target cadence? weekly start slots? :calendar:

alex: thinking start every 2 weeks so ops can onboard and we can iterate prompts + evals between cohorts. timeline: 2wk onboarding + 1wk active feedback = 3 weeks total.

sam: +1. can we scope a lightweight acceptance criteria to speed selection? we don't need fully fleshed pilots.

alex: yes — acceptance checklist suggestion: 1) product fit signal (3 use-case examples), 2) security sign-off for data handling (SaaS vs. private), 3) a named PM or eng contact, 4) willingness to run 2 short eval scripts and 1 async interview.

joni: can we standardize the eval scripts so results are comparable across cohorts? also, how do we measure "quality delta"?

alex: plan: two canonical eval sets per vertical + one open-ended prompt set. quality delta = delta in our eval score vs baseline model on those prompts (percent pass rate on guardrail checks and human rating). infra cost delta = tokens-per-session and average latency bucket change compared to current hosted baseline.

maria: regarding compensation / incentives — propose credits + 1:1 review session + co-marketing mention for good partners. low friction.

sam: operational ask: we'll need a single invite template, plus a small automation to capture onboarding answers into Airtable. i can wire that.

alex: sample invite (please copy/edit):
```
Hi <partner>,
We run small micro-cohorts to validate product fit and set launch priorities. 3 weeks, 8 teams per cohort. You'll get early access to Redwood features, usage credits, and a follow-up 1:1. If interested, please answer 4 quick questions and sign our short NDA.
```

joni: add one question in the form asking whether they require private deployment / dedicated capacity. that changes consent & timeline.

alex: good call. we'll route private/dedicated candidates to the enterprise onboarding lane.

maria: feedback loops — propose: weekly async survey (3 questions), a short in-product feedback widget (1-click thumbs + optional text), and a scheduled 30–45m interview at the end. also a lightweight daily slack channel for the cohort?

sam: weekly async + one end interview is enough. daily slack might be high overhead. maybe a single cohort thread with pinned issues.

alex: agreed. design:
- onboarding form -> Airtable tags (vertical, infra need, primary contact)
- onboarding packet + short checklist (security, data handling, sample prompts)
- eval harness: run canonical prompts pre/post + collect human ratings
- weekly async survey: ease-of-use, blockers, feature asks (3 fields)
- end interview: 30m, recorded notes, one follow-up action item per partner

maria: rollout risk: legal/NDA review could block start. recommend an "express NDA" template (one-page) and pre-approved by legal for cohorts. i'll talk to legal.

alex: ops owners: sam owns invite automation + Airtable flow, joni owns eval harness and prompt sets, maria owns recruitment messaging and legal sync. I'll own cohort prioritization & final selection.

sam: infra note — we should bake in simple telemetry flags so we can segment by cohort for latency/cost dashboards. small schema: cohort_id, partner_id, session_id, avg_latency_ms, tokens_in, pass_rate.

alex: good. add webhook from runtime to a cohort events endpoint for real time monitoring. devops/infra will approve path.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: cohort-01-invite sent by @sam at 2025-10-12T15:00Z

maria: success criteria (proposal):
- Recruitment: 80% of invited accept within 7 days for first two cohorts
- Engagement: 70% complete weekly survey and do the end interview
- Product signal: identify top 3 feature asks with at least 3 partners requesting each
- Quality regressions: no >5% drop vs baseline on canonical evals when enabling suggested optimizations
- Economic signal: document average tokens/session and estimate unit cost impact for 3 pilot apps

joni: add a gating rule: if more than 2 partners report unresolved security/data blockers after onboarding week, pause cohort rollouts until mitigations are in place.

sam: timeline: cohort-0 (internal alpha) next week with staff volunteers, cohort-1 general invite 2025-10-20, cohort-2 starts 2025-11-03.

alex: content needed this week: invite template, onboarding packet, eval scripts, Airtable schema, legal NDA draft. owners acknowledged above.

maria: i'll draft invite + NDA and drop in the product / recruitment folder.

sam: i'll build the Airtable form and webhook. joni, can you draft one vertical eval pack (search & summarization) by Fri?

joni: yep, will do. also will prepare a one-pager on scoring rubric (pass/fail heuristics + human rating scale).

alex: perfect. follow-ups: 1) sync with legal (maria), 2) infra telemetry spike (sam), 3) eval pack + rubric (joni). check-in in this thread Friday EOD.

maria: :thumbsup:

sam: done, starting now.

alex: thanks all. if anyone wants to join cohort-0 testing, ping me.
